answer: A farm of 351 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in nebula, queued in quartz, and violet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 19 identities per epoch. A farm of 2809 identities would post 3362 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
